All property names use namespace prefixes as declared in the

). The CDIF JSON-LD implementation uses a hierarchical JSON structure, and CURIE syntax to abbreviate URIs using prefixes defined in the JSON-LD context. The implementation does not map un-prefixed JSON keys to URIs; rather, it prefixes a namespace abbreviation on the key label to represent the URI. This enables using standard JSON Schema to validate documents and avoids confusion about the vocabulary origin of keys used in the JSON.
